verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention periods, TTL settings, or trace and dataset deletion controls for LangSmith. The closest item is self-hosting, which keeps trace data in your own environment (langsmith-docs-48). That concerns where data lives, not control over how long it is kept or how it is deleted, so it is an adjacent capability that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
